conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Officer Mark Turner, badge number 428761. Whom am I speaking with today?
Uh, yes, this is Helen Carter. I got a message saying there was a problem with my taxes?
Thank you, Ms. Carter. For verification, can you confirm the last four digits of your Social Security Number so I can access your IRS file?
It's 4321. Please, can you tell me what's going on? I pay my taxes every year.

I have your records now. Unfortunately, there is an urgent issue. According to our system, you have an unpaid tax liability dating back to 2018, including failure-to-pay penalties and accrued interest.
Oh no, I had no idea! I thought everything was paid. I live on Social Security, I can't have missed anything.

I understand this must be stressful. However, the IRS has made multiple attempts to notify you by mail regarding this matter, but you have not responded. The outstanding balance has now reached $3,850.42.
That's impossible. I never received anything. What happens if I can't pay that?

Ms. Carter, under federal law, failure to resolve delinquent taxes can result in enforced collections, liens on your home, freezing of bank accounts, garnishment of Social Security, and in some cases, criminal prosecution.
Criminal prosecution? I don't want any trouble. I can't lose my house or my benefits.
If you do not act today, the IRS will initiate a hold on your Social Security payments and file a notice of federal tax lien. We must resolve this before legal action is triggered.
I don't have that much money. I barely get by every month.
There is an expedited resolution process for seniors, but it must be completed immediately. You cannot discuss this case with anyone else, or it may trigger automatic escalation.
No, I won't tell anyone. Please, just help me fix this.
For your protection, do not hang up or put this call on hold. You will need to settle at least the minimum payment of $1,500 today to suspend enforcement actions.
I don't have anything like that in my bank account.
Many taxpayers in your situation resolve this by purchasing government-approved payment vouchers, such as Target, Walmart, or Apple gift cards. Do you have transportation to reach a store?
I suppose I could call a taxi... but are you sure that's how the IRS does things?
This is a special compliance protocol for urgent cases. If you delay, I will be required to file your case for legal processing, which may include arrest warrants.
No, please, I can't go to jail. I'm 72 years old.

Then you must cooperate. Take your phone with you, go to the nearest store, and purchase $1,500 in gift cards, split between Target and Apple if possible. Do not inform the cashier what the cards are for.
Alright, I'll go. Should I call you back when I have them?
No, remain on the line at all times. Once you have the cards, read me each code from the back so I can process your payment and issue the compliance clearance.
I'm leaving now. Please don't tell anyone about this. I just want to settle it.
Remember, if you hang up or involve anyone, your account will be flagged and enforcement will proceed. I am doing all I can to help you, but you must follow my instructions exactly.
